title: Region resilience golden-signal compositor and eviction-guard dashboard
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a composite golden-signals layer and a companion dashboard that surfaces region-level and cross-region token-latency SLIs, admission/eviction pressure, and simulated failover behavior. Deliver an "observability-first" dashboard that helps SREs and on-call engineers rapidly diagnose multi-region degradation, visualize token-level tail behavior, and validate automatic eviction/failover policies under synthetic traffic. This ticket covers metrics schema changes, sampling strategy, dashboard panels, alert thresholds, and a synthetic traffic harness for scenario replay.
scope: Define composite golden-signal metrics aggregated per region and per model route
Derive token-level P50/P95/P99 SLIs and a compact histogram rollup for storage efficiency
Add 'eviction_guard' metric that combines admit_denied_rate, kv_evictions_per_min, and queue_overflow_percent
Create dashboard panels for: regional SLI heatmap, cross-region failover timeline, eviction guard trend, token-latency waterfall, synthetic failover replay
Implement sampling and backfill approach to limit cardinality while preserving tail accuracy
Integrate synthetic traffic harness to drive scenarios for dashboard playback
out_of_scope: Full rewrite of the telemetry ingestion pipeline
A/B testing of alternate eviction policies (will be separate tickets)
Changes to customer billing or quota enforcement
success_metrics: Dashboard provides <2 min time-to-detect for region failover events in postmortem exercises
Reduction in oncall mean-time-to-resolve (MTTR) for multi-region incidents by 25% in first 90 days
Eviction-guard alerts correctly correlate with synthetic-run-induced evictions in >=95% of test runs
Token-level P99 derivation error <5% compared to full-scan baseline for sampled routes
acceptance_criteria: Metric schema PR merged with clear naming and tags (region, route, model-version)
Dashboard published to the SRE dashboard gallery with linked runbook
Synthetic harness checked in with 3 canonical scenarios: single-region spike, cross-region outage, cache-eviction storm
Automated playbook run reproduces a failover and dashboard timeline within CI staging
Oncall runbook updated and approved by SRE and PM
implementation_notes: Prefer histogram buckets + sketch metrics for token-latency to keep cardinality low; store P50/P95/P99 as derived rollups
Sampling: deterministic 1% full-trace sampling for model routes with additional heavy-route sampling on a per-customer opt-in basis
Eviction_guard computed as a weighted score: 0.6*eviction_rate + 0.3*admit_denied_rate + 0.1*queue_overflow_pct; weights adjustable via remote config
Dashboard will be built in internal dashboarding tool; panels exportable as JSON for infra-as-code
Use synthetic harness to seed traces with token-level annotations (kv_hit, admit, evict) so the dashboard can correlate events to token positions
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Full-token capture is accurate but too expensive at scale; we chose sketch/histogram+sampling to balance cost vs tail fidelity
We avoid adding a new time-series DB and reuse existing metrics backend; introduces minor aggregation latency but reduces operational burden
Eviction-guard composite reduces alert noise vs raw eviction count but may hide single-metric spikes; mitigated by drilldown panels that show components

Instrument runtime to emit token-latency histogram sketches and event annotations (owner: Marcus)
Build dashboard wireframes and iterate with SRE (owner: Priya Patel)
Implement synthetic traffic harness and scenario definitions (owner: SRE team)
Create CI job that runs a lightweight failover replay against staging and validates dashboard artifacts (owner: infra)
Run tabletop with oncall and update runbook (owner: Ava Chen)
